comparison.objective: Draw a pan from the back of a deep oven with a peel and then lift it out; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-reach tool-mediated support, sliding, and transfer versus small recessed-tool alignment, bimanual impact, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Pan drawn within reach and lifted out versus four safe fractures and complete fragment containment.
comparison.reason: Tool-mediated extraction of a supported pan is materially different from impact fracture. The record provides no body, motion thresholds, or damage rubric.
